resources.string: ScrollCapture uses this service to automatically scroll content on your screen during a capture session. This allows hands-free capture of long documents, chat conversations, and articles.
Shows when screen capture is active
Shows when the floating overlay is active
ScrollCapture needs to record your screen to capture text from any app. Your screen content is processed entirely on-device and never leaves your phone.
Enable the accessibility service to let ScrollCapture automatically scroll through content for hands-free capture. This is optional — you can always scroll manually.
ScrollCapture needs to show a floating bubble over other apps so you can control capture sessions while using any app.
